lines.zh: 我挪着步子走到货架后面。
lines.en: I shuffle behind the shelves.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，货物不能碰倒。
lines.en: I walk steadily; the goods must not fall.
I make one circuit of the market.

lines.zh: 我从摊位那头走到这头。
lines.en: I go from that end of the stall to this one.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮出声。
lines.en: My claws scrape the floor.

lines.zh: 我走得不远，就在村里转。
lines.en: I do not go far; I circle the village.
I stop and count the goods.
I step around the baskets.

lines.zh: 我往洞厅深处走了一段。
lines.en: I walk a stretch into the deep hall.
I squeeze sideways down the narrow way.

lines.zh: 我站在货架边上，抱着手臂。
lines.en: I stand by the shelves with my arms folded.

lines.zh: 我不追水果，我在这里等。
lines.en: I do not chase fruit; I wait here.
The goods in this stall are mine.

lines.zh: 我在心里把今天的账算清。
lines.en: I am settling today's accounts in my head.
I have few customers.
I touch the pouch at my belt.

lines.zh: 这里的光是从地衣来的。
lines.en: The light here comes from lichen.
I raise my head and listen above.
My people are all below.
I set one item straight.
I make no sound; I only watch.
I am the richest in this village.
I draw my hands into my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我在等一笔合适的买卖。
lines.en: I am waiting for a good trade.
I count the price on my fingers.
Have you brought anything?

lines.zh: 我抬手，示意你靠近货架。
lines.en: I raise a hand for you to come to the shelves.
You do not look wealthy.

lines.zh: 我看的是你的包，不是你。
lines.en: I am looking at your pack, not at you.
What do you plan to trade?
I do not take junk here.
Put your hands down; do not touch the goods.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，挡住货。
lines.en: I shift half a step to block the goods.
I care only about the goods you carry.
Do not put your hands on the rack.
I shield the shelf and give half a step.
I have priced that blow.
I press the wound without a sound.
My people close around me.
I raise my head, eyes hard.
That should not have happened.
I hide the pouch behind me.
I straightened my back.
You have stirred the whole village.
I raise a hand to hold my people back.
Fruit? I no longer chase it.
Are you offering that in trade?
I have some of that myself.
I will not take this one.
I lifted a hand; no interest.
Bring something rare.
That one is worth very little.
I look at it and put it down.
What would you trade it for?
That one we can sit down over.
You bump me and the goods rock.
I steady the shelf with a hand.
I move aside to shield the goods.
Mind your feet; do not knock the stock over.
I have entered that in the ledger.
Both my legs are set in the floor.
Please step behind the line.
My people are all watching.

lines.zh: 你撞到货架，我伸爪挡了一下。
lines.en: You knock the shelf; I put a claw out to stop it.
This stall must not be thrown into disorder.

lines.zh: 我的位置是靠这个换来的。
lines.en: My place was earned by trade.
I speak little of such things.
I have a home, below.
I drew my hands back into my sleeves.
What matters now is the stock.
I turn back to the accounts.
That is not a piece of business.
I waved a finger and did not answer.
My time is expensive. Let's see the goods.
I will not take that question.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的紫水晶，我掂了掂。
lines.en: A dropped amethyst cluster; I weigh it in my palm.
The quality is poor.
This can go into stock.

lines.zh: 那块回响碎片，对着光照了照。
lines.en: An echo shard; I hold it up to the light.
This one is worth nothing.
I have entered it in the ledger.
This is not my stock.

lines.zh: 这筐果子不该在这儿，我推回原位。
lines.en: This basket of fruit is out of place; I shove it back.
I am keeping this one.
I raise my head and narrow my eyes.
Have you come to rob me?
I put a hand on the shelf.
My people will come.
I have been in this village too long.
This stall is worth a good deal.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一步，护住钱袋。
lines.en: I step back to guard my purse.
I am ready on this side.
Do not push me that far.
I push my sleeves up.
We dug all of this.
The richest in the village: me.

lines.zh: 没有人能在这儿抢东西。
lines.en: No one robs anyone here.
I shouted back into the burrow.
I stand across the front of the shelves.
If you want a fight, you will have one.
I have this moment reckoned clearly.

lines.zh: 货架我守着，你别打歪主意。
lines.en: I guard these shelves; don't get ideas.
You go left; I shift left.
I stand between the shelves and the door.
I do not chase out; I hold.
My hand has not left the goods.
I called a second time.
My people's steps are closer.

lines.zh: 这一条道只有一个出口。
lines.en: This passage has one way out.
I took the centre of the passage.
I have reckoned this distance.
My claws hook the seams of the flagstones.
Try reaching again.

lines.zh: 这里每块石头我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone here.
More of my people are above.
I am in no hurry; this is my home.
You are not getting out this way.
I move the lamp aside.
I take the narrowest point.
That is my last word.
I slam into the edge of the shelf.
I shoulder you back.
I know how hard that was.

lines.zh: 我抓起一件东西砸过去。
lines.en: I snatch up an item and throw it.
Don't touch the market goods.
I pull back and cover the goods.
You knocked over a basket.

lines.zh: 爪子收着，我只想把你赶出去。
lines.en: Claws sheathed; I only mean to drive you out.
I plant myself across the doorway.
My people have closed in.
I am panting, and I have not backed off.
I raise a hand and point at the door.
That blow should not have been struck.
I come out from behind the shelves.
The lamps below brighten a little.
There is one more figure in the market.
I take my place before the stall.
The lichen light falls on my face.
I straighten my stall.
I have come up out of the burrow.
This stall has just opened.
Check the surroundings. Don't lose the goods.
I wait with my arms folded.
I dug this earth.
I stand in the brightest spot.
I set the pouch at my feet.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，就去理货。
lines.en: I glance at you and go back to the stock.
We can trade here.
I raise my head and look at the lamp.
The village knows me.
I rest a hand on the goods.
What would you like to look at?

lines.zh: 火把货架点着了，我扑上去拍。
lines.en: Fire catches the shelf; I throw myself at it.
I hit the floor and my pouch spills.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我抓着石边往上。
lines.en: Water floods in; I claw up the stone.

lines.zh: 爆风把货摊掀翻，我扑向散落的货。
lines.en: The blast scatters the stall and I dive for the goods.
Something lodged in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我抵着货架撑住。
lines.en: Some force bears down; I brace on the shelf.
Even the stores below are running low.

lines.zh: 雷顺着地面传过来，我整条腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs along the floor and my leg goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: The floor is gone and there is nothing to hold.
